coaching.headline: Legion killed four of us 16 times while two of five bought armor; we held Orb Prime and still lost.
coaching.team: We lost this to one hero and never adjusted. Legion killed four of us 16 times, all seven of Muriel's deaths and four of Murdock's nine among them, and only two of five bought armor. The early game was a trade: Gideon and Murdock died at their Fangtooth at 9.5 and we took Mini Prime at 11. The middle was the duo dying two-man. Muriel and Murdock lost 0-2 to Legion and Steel at Fangtooth at 24.6 and again at their inner tower at 28.1, and one of our towers fell soon after each. At 30.9 Legion alone killed three of us with five of ours alive to their three, and Primal Fangtooth went to them. There was still a way back: the fight at their inhibitor at 33.8, won 3-1, was followed by Orb Prime and the Genesis Core. Then Murdock was caught alone by Shinbi at 36.7, the last fight was 4v5 at our core, and our core fell at 38.1. Next game: everyone their carry has killed buys armor on the next back.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The duo fights taken two-man. Muriel and Murdock took Legion and Steel two-on-two at Fangtooth at 24.6 and at their inner tower at 28.1, lost both 0-2, and one of our towers fell soon after each. Then 30.9: five of us alive, and Legion killed three.
coaching.whatWorked: Vision and conversion. We placed 50 wards to their 34, and every fight we won was cashed: the fight at 23.2, won 3-1, became their outer tower and Fangtooth within a minute.

loadout.name: Death From Above
loadout.text: Akeron can fire an additional web projectile from the wall or ground once, allowing him to leap from surface to surface or to Root from where he hangs.
loadout.plain: Web Lash gets a second shot from a wall, so you can swing to another wall or root an enemy from above. It makes ganks and escapes much harder to predict.

loadout.plain: Staying in fights with heroes builds up power and armor over time, and each level-up or takedown makes it permanently stronger. Suits Akeron's long brawls with Hellfire and Crushing Maw.
